newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia airline confirms deal for eight A320s.
newsitem.headline: Colombia airline confirms deal for eight A320s.

text.p: Colombian international and domestic airline ACES Monday confirmed the acquisition of eight Airbus Industrie A320 aircraft.
It issued a communique saying the planes, worth $40 million each, will be acquired through a financial leasing system, following an agreement with its pilots' association.
ACES plans to use the aircraft on its domestic routes between the capital Bogot and the cities of Cali, Medelln, Barranquilla and Cartagena.
A company spokeswoman said the aircraft would be delivered in pairs starting in November and would gradually replace the fleet of Boeing B-727s that currently fly these routes.
